description: Create a sales channel, at most 20 per workspace; a duplicate key is refused. The channel prices nothing until a price list is published to it (create_price_list / update_price_list with channels): one undated base list plus dated lists whose windows do not overlap. Channel keys are public - any storefront can send one - so priceAccess decides who sees its prices and may buy through it. currency picks what the channel sells in (the default currency when omitted): its carts, orders, shipping and discounts are in it, and a product with no price in it is not sold there.

currency.description: The currency the channel sells in: the workspace's default currency (or null) or one of its additional currencies (update_cart_config additionalCurrencies)

displayMode.description: How visitors and customers without a company read the channel's prices: net (VAT added on top) or gross (VAT inside). Default gross; a company buyer keeps their company's mode.

key.description: What the storefront sends as channel: 1-40 lowercase letters and digits, words joined by - or _ (e.g. 'horeca'). Cannot change later; orders keep it.

priceAccess.description: Who sees the channel's prices and may buy through it: PUBLIC - anyone (default); MEMBERS - signed-in customers, and registration is open; COMPANY_MEMBERS - buyers of an approved company, the one to use for trade prices. Others get prices withheld and carts refused.
